rawFindings.title: Paginator ignores pagination values stored on page locals
rawFindings.explanation: Template locals store generated page data under `this.page` (the `Locals` constructor extends `this.page` with generator locals), so a normal paginated template calling `paginator()` has `this.page.current`/`this.page.total`, not `this.current`/`this.total`. This line now falls back to `0` instead of the actual current page, and the following total fallback similarly ignores `this.page.total`.
rawFindings.suggestion: Read from page locals as before, e.g. `var current = options.current || this.page.current || 0;` and `var total = options.total || this.page.total || 1;` (or include `this.page && ...` guards if needed).
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With template context `{ page: { current: 5, total: 10, base: '', path: 'page/5/' } }`, calling `paginator({space: ''})` now renders a current page of `0` plus a link to page `1`, instead of rendering page `5` as current with links around it up to total `10`.
